Paper: Monochromatic Sublattices in Random and Cardinality Colourings of the Boolean Lattice, by Deep Bhattacharjee.

- f(n) ≤ (1 + o(1)) n log₂ n, from random colourings (in a random k-colouring the largest monochromatic sublattice has (1 ± o(1)) n log_k n members).
- Optimal cardinality colourings for n ≤ 25, with SAT certificates.
- f(n) exactly for n ≤ 22 and n = 24; 13 ≤ f(23) ≤ 14, 14 ≤ f(25) ≤ 15.
- Not a full closure: the order of growth of f(n) is open.

Files: the PDF, the LaTeX source with PNG figures, and the arXiv tarball.
